summary.text: PP is polypropylene. Makers sell it for lightweight and chemically exposed parts such as drones and toys, and a maker warns it turns brittle at sub-zero temperatures. Its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 59 °C. On the H2C it prints at 225⁠–⁠230 °C with no heated chamber, but Prusa Research's knowledge base says unfilled polypropylene adheres poorly to the bed and warps.

items.text: Centaur PP combines a unique set of material properties into a 3D printer filament, which makes Centaur PP an extremely diverse and multi-functional material suitable for numerous applications ranging from 3D printing dishwasher proof and microwave safe household articles to functional engineering objects with great endurance properties.
It can, amongst others, be used for functional engineering parts and household items.
Centaur PP is a lightweight and high-performance Polypropylene (PP) filament.
It is an extremely diverse and multifunctional material.
It is both dishwasher and microwave proof.
Centaur PP has outstanding mechanical properties and a superb interlayer adhesion.
Food contact compliant natural variant
Dishwasher proof and microwave safe
Watertight printing possible with only single wall prints
Great elastic properties
Can stretch up to >600% before breaking
Improved wear-, abrasion- and fatigue resistance
High chemical resistance
Centaur PP is a lightweight and high-performance Polypropylene (PP) filament, which is engineered to have outstanding mechanical properties and a superb interlayer adhesion.
Centaur PP 3D prints with a superb interlayer adhesion and features outstanding mechanical properties.
Excellent interlayer adhesion
Large Centaur PP prints can be printed on an unheated 2mm or 3mm PP plate, which can be attached to the print bed.
Smaller prints can be printed on standard PP packaging tape.

Pegasus PP-HGS25 is a PP filament that is enhanced with hollow glass nanotechnology, which makes this 3D printer filament 20% lighter than virgin PP filaments.

The modification with 25% hollow glass microspheres made from soda-lime borosilicate glass not only make Pegasus PP-HGS25 an extremely lightweight filament, but also significantly stiffer than normal PP filament.

The inherent properties of the added hollow glass microspheres provide a number of unique performance advantages, such as weight reduction, dimensional stability, thermal insulation and a lower dielectric constant.
